limits: Byte identity is not runtime parity.
The disclosure-pass Bun/TypeScript run did not start because the harmless offline sandbox preflight returned EPERM. No containment bypass or retry occurred.

A later review-fix run on a scratch install of this candidate observed Bun 1.4.2: bun install --frozen-lockfile through the session proxy, bun test orch watch-pr 52 of 52 passing and tsc --strict --noEmit (TypeScript 7.0.2) exiting 0 for watch-pr. Bound helper reads still passed with the installed node_modules present.
The Node plan gate differs from upstream and passed current installed Node tests.
Python installed helpers changed during consolidation and are covered separately by current adapter tests. Progressive disclosure only changes their bound inventory/hash constants.

The review-bot change adapts five watch-pr files and adds a plan-check test. They ran under Bun and tsc on a local install; recognition of the Claude and Codex logins is checked against synthetic GraphQL fixtures only, and no review bot has been observed on a PR here.
